# DriveLink

> DriveLink is a U.S. marketplace and payment-protection service for private car sales. The buyer pays the seller's own Stripe account directly, and DriveLink never holds the money. The seller can't withdraw it to their bank until the buyer has the keys and the signed title and gives the seller a 6-digit handover code. DriveLink LLC is registered in New Jersey. U.S. transactions only.

## How it works
- The buyer pays through DriveLink. The money is held by Stripe, not released to the seller yet.
- At the handover, the buyer gives the seller a 6-digit code. The seller enters it and the funds are released.
- Works on a car listed on DriveLink or one found elsewhere (Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, a friend).
- Deals up to $250,000. Buyers can pay by card, or by wire transfer on any purchase of $500 or more.
- If something goes wrong, the buyer can open a dispute and the money stays held until it is resolved.

## Fees
- $0 to list. Buyers pay nothing beyond the price of the car.
- Sellers pay a percentage of the sale price when the deal closes (0.5% during the October 2026 offer, normally 1%). Nothing if the deal falls through.
- Card or bank processing is charged by Stripe.
